name: pachca
description: Connect your AI agent to Pachca team chat: the MCP server with a tool per API method, plus nine skills, from summarizing a thread to watching one and replying in it.

PACHCA_TOKEN.title: Pachca token
PACHCA_TOKEN.description: A Pachca personal token or bot token. Cursor reads the PACHCA_TOKEN environment variable first. A value set here for a team is shared by every member, so the whole team would act as one employee or bot.
